SchoolApp

A modern, natively designed iOS application built to manage a student directory. This project demonstrates core SwiftUI concepts, reactive state management, and local data persistence using SwiftData.

Features:

* Student Directory: Add new students with their names and GPA scores. View a complete list of all registered students.
* Local Persistence: Fully utilizes SwiftData to save student records locally, ensuring data remains intact between app launches.
* Detailed Profiles: Tap on any student to view their automatically generated profile card and academic status (Excellent/Good) based on their GPA.
* State Management Demo: Includes a reactive Status Tracker and interactive Name Card to demonstrate SwiftUI state management.
* Native Apple Design: Features a clean, standard iOS user interface using SF Pro typography, plain lists, and SF Symbols for a true native feel.

Tech Stack:

* Language: Swift
* UI Framework: SwiftUI
* Database: SwiftData
* Environment: Xcode (macOS)

How to Run the Project:

1. Clone or download this repository to your local machine.
2. Open the SchoolApp.xcodeproj file in Xcode.
3. At the top center of the Xcode window, select an iOS Simulator (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 16). Note: Do not select "My Mac" unless you have specifically configured the macOS target.
4. Press Cmd + R (or click the Play button) to build and run the application.
